# UNIFIED METRIC-SPACE CLUSTERING: LST from T3s onward

Design commitment: T5 and T4 die as combinatoric objects. Every surviving T3 carries a learned 8-dim embedding produced by one network whose per-T3 cost is already paid today (t3dnn slot). Track building is graph clustering over the hard topological prior "T3s sharing an MD," edge acceptance is embedding distance, components are found by GPU/CPU union-find, and ONE track-level classifier scores each component. pLS attach into the same metric space via a pixel head, bucketed by origin-free helix invariants instead of the 45000-superbin maps.

---

## 1. ARCHITECTURE

Pipeline (stages A–C = MD/LS/T3 unchanged except the T3 tail):

**K1. CreateTriplets (kept, tail modified).** Same enumeration and workdiv as today ({module,1,1}×{1,16,16}; O(h⁴) pair scans, O(h³) MD-matched survivors in core multiplicity h; Triplet.h:610-713). The tail swap: `t3dnn::runInference` is replaced by `t3net` (Sec. 3), which writes an 8-dim embedding + 1 fake logit per accepted T3 into TripletsSoA (replacing the fakeScore/promptScore/displacedScore columns). Gate: single loose threshold on the fake logit (one scalar, replacing the 4×10 t3dnn WP tables). Pointing constraint and RZ constraint kept as-is in Phase 1 (known limitations, addendum in Sec. 5).

**K2. BuildMDIndex.** CSR adjacency MD→T3 by position: for each T3, register (firstMD, pos0), (midMD, pos1), (lastMD, pos2). Grid-stride, one thread per T3; atomic counts → single-block prefix sum → fill. O(nT3), ~3 atomics/T3. This index is the structural fix: today MD-sharing is a scan test with no MD→object index, forcing the O(h⁶) visit count (Triplet.h:645, Quintuplet.h:1764).

**K3. LinkT3s.** For each MD, candidate edges = (T3s with this MD at pos2) × (T3s with it at pos0) [T5-pattern chain] plus (pos1×pos0 with second-MD equality) [T4-pattern, shared-LS chain]. Pair space is prefix-summed per MD; grid-stride one thread per candidate pair — no block-per-module serialization, no dense-path fallback. Per pair: 8-dim d²(eᵢ,eⱼ) (16 FLOP) + two origin-free consistency windows (|Δκ|, |Δtanλ| from stored T3 fit quantities, ~10 FLOP) + degree bookkeeping. Accepted edge ⇒ immediate `union(i,j)` via atomicCas union-find with path compression (ECL-CC style; compiles to plain ops on serial CPU) and append to a compact edge list for K6/K10. Asymptotic: O(Σ_MD deg_end·deg_start) = O(h⁵) in a jet core — the number of genuine MD-matched pairs — with a ~50 FLOP constant. Today the same pairs cost O(h⁶) scans + O(h⁵)×(~40 loads + 1900 MACs), executed twice, on one 256-thread block.

**K4. FlattenCC.** Pointer-jumping to root; one thread per T3; O(nT3·α).

**K5. CompactComponents.** Roots → dense component ids (atomic enumerate), CSR component→T3 lists, per-component: centroid embedding (mean of member e's), layer bitmask over 11 logical OT layers, member count. O(nT3).

**K6. MergeAdjacent (anti-fragmentation).** Over the stored edge list's *rejected* near-miss pairs and cross-component MD-shared pairs (same CSR): if two components' centroids satisfy d² < τ_merge and fitted κ/tanλ agree, union them. One thread per candidate; O(h⁵) worst, tiny constant, one extra flatten.

**K7. PixelEmbed.** `plsnet` per pLS (replaces plsembdnn in the same slot, Segment.h:306). O(n_pLS).

**K8. BuildInvariantGrid.** Bucket every component by quantized origin-free helix invariants from its fit (K9 runs a cheap 3-point pre-fit first, or K8 runs after K9 — order: K9 then K8): key = (φ_c = atan2(c_y,c_x): 64 bins, tanλ: 32 bins, signed log|κ|: 16 bins) → 32768 buckets, CSR fill. Bin widths ≥3σ of the pixel-vs-OT parameter residual so a 3×3×3 probe is exhaustive. One thread per component; O(n_comp).

**K9. FitComponents.** One block (128 threads) per component: gather member hits (≤~30 after per-layer dedup), N-point weighted algebraic circle fit + s-z line fit (generalizing the existing `computeRadiusUsingRegression` code), per-layer best-residual hit selection (≤2 hits/layer, up to 11 layers), outputs κ, (c_x,c_y), tanλ, χ²_rφ, χ²_rz, nLayers, dca=| |c|−R |. O(n_comp × hits).

**K10. SplitComponents.** Only components flagged (nLayers>7 with >2 hits/layer somewhere, or χ² above sanity, or member count > cap): 2-means in embedding space seeded by the two most-separated member T3s, helix refit per half, keep split if summed χ² improves. Block per flagged component; rare outside jet cores. This is the overlap-aware answer to fake-T3 bridging.

**K11. AttachPLS.** One thread per non-dup quad pLS: probe 27 grid buckets, for each candidate component compute d²(e_pLS, centroid) + κ/tanλ windows; take best; attach if d² < τ_pix. O(n_pLS × c), c ≈ 10–30 candidates. Multiple pLS attaching to one component: keep min-d², mark others dup — this *is* the pLS-vs-track crossclean.

**K12. ScoreTC (tcnet) + EmitTCs.** One thread per component: tcnet forward (~1.7k MAC), one global threshold θ (optionally θ_pix/θ_OT); accepted components written as TCs (pixel-attached → pT5-like type, else T5/T4-like by nLayers, preserving downstream type contract); unattached non-dup quad pLS emitted as pLS TCs exactly as today. O(n_comp + n_pLS).

Dedup is structurally free: components partition T3s, so there are no duplicate track objects to remove; the residual failure modes are handled by K6 (fragmentation) and K10 (merging), both cheap and local.

---

## 2. WHAT GETS DELETED

**Kernels** (src/alpaka): CountTripletConnections[ReduceMem], CreateEligibleModulesListForQuintuplets, CreateQuintuplets[ReduceMem], ExtendT5FromDupT5, RemoveDupQuintupletsAfterBuild, RemoveDupQuintupletsBeforeTC (the ~10⁹-op single-thread quadratic), AddQuintupletRangesToEventExplicit; CountTripletLSConnections, CreateEligibleModulesListForQuadruplets, CreateQuadruplets, RemoveDupQuadrupletsAfterBuild/BeforeTC, AddQuadrupletRangesToEventExplicit; CreatePixelQuintupletsFromMap, RemoveDupPixelQuintupletsFromMap, CreatePixelTripletsFromMap, RemoveDupPixelTripletsFromMap; CrossCleanpT3, CrossCleanT5, CrossCleanT4, CrossCleanpLS; CheckHitspLS second pass; AddpT5/AddpT3/AddT5/AddT4 (folded into EmitTCs); the two host superbin-resolution loops + D2H/H2D bounces (LSTEvent.dev.cc:807-877, 1077-1148).

**Heuristic machinery**: runQuintupletdBetaAlgoSelector + runDeltaBetaIterations (~600 lines, explicitly beam-spot-referenced via kDeltaZLum); passT5RZConstraint's 20-region tight/loose tables + tightCutFlag; passT4RZConstraint's 25-bin table; T4 anti-prompt dxy veto; passPT5RZ/RPhi/Inwards chi2 tables; passPT3RZ tables; PPBB/PPEE tracklet chains; all dedup dEta/dPhi windows, shared-hit thresholds, and tiebreak conventions for T5/T4/pT3/pT5; the kNTripletThreshold=1000 dense-serialization path.

**NNs**: t5dnn, t5embdnn, t4dnn, pt3dnn, plsembdnn deleted; t3dnn replaced. 6 → 3 networks.

**WP tables**: t3dnn kWp_prompt/kWp_displaced (2×2×10), t5dnn kWp (2×10), pt3dnn kWp_pT3/kWpHigh/kWp_pT5/kWpHigh (22 values), t4dnn kWp_displaced/kWp_fake (2×2×25), plsembdnn kWP (10) — all replaced by 5 scalars: f_T3 (fake gate), τ_edge, τ_merge, τ_pix, θ_tc.

**Maps/caps**: the 12 pixelmap binary files, PixelMap SoA + getConnectedPixels flattening, superbin computation, pixelType 2 GeV split; caps n_max_pixel_triplets=5000, n_max_pixel_quintuplets=15000 (the silent jet-core cliffs), kMaxCompatModules=40. Kept: TC output caps, pLS input cap, module connection map (upstream, out of scope).

**SoAs**: QuintupletsSoA, QuadrupletsSoA, PixelTripletsSoA, PixelQuintupletsSoA (~20-40 MB/event at PU200 multiplicities) replaced by edge list + component CSR (~5 MB).

---

## 3. NN SPECIFICATION (3 networks)

**t3net — 24 → 32 → 32 → (8 embed + 1 fake), ~2.1k MAC (~4.2 kFLOP; t3dnn today: 1.6k MAC).** Invoked exactly where t3dnn is today (Triplet.h:510). Inputs, with displaced-safety justification:
- (1–3) logicalLayer/16 of the 3 modules; (4–5) moduleType of inner/outer module. Detector context (resolution, material), not track-origin quantities.
- (6–7) Δr steps (r₂−r₁, r₃−r₂)/kR_max; (8–9) Δz steps /kZ_max; (10–11) deltaPhi steps between consecutive hits. Chord properties of the 3 hits; translation-invariant w.r.t. track origin.
- (12) signed curvature κ = q·1/R from the 3-hit circle (origin-free; already computed).
- (13–14) circle center (c_x, c_y)/kR_max. Origin-free trajectory property; required so the embedding can encode "same circle." Risk: the fake head could learn the prompt shortcut | |c|−R | ≈ 0; mitigated by displaced-balanced training and an eff-vs-dxy flatness validation gate (Sec. 5), not by feature deletion, because the embedding needs the center.
- (15) tanλ = Δz/Δs from the fit (origin-free replacement for eta-of-position).
- (16) bending angle between (h₂−h₁) and (h₃−h₂) in xy (origin-free sagitta; replaces IP-referenced betaIn).
- (17–18) r-z residual of middle hit vs 1–3 line; RZ helix χ² (reuse passRZConstraint arithmetic without its threshold). Origin-free (3-hit helix).
- (19–20) r₁/kR_max, |z₁|/kZ_max. Position context so the net knows the detector region; positions are legitimate — the displaced killer is position-as-direction proxies (eta/phi of hit 1, betaIn), all of which are **excluded**. Balance in training prevents position-direction shortcut learning.
- (21–24) same-layer/skipped-layer flags, drdz of tilted modules, PS/2S pitch class of middle module, charge sign.
Outputs: e ∈ R⁸ (metric embedding; same-sim-track T3s close), fake logit (loose gate). The embedding's job is geometrically easy: two T3s of one track share (κ, c_x, c_y, tanλ, z-intercept-at-reference) — all origin-free — so a geometric warm-start (train fc3 to predict these, then contrastive fine-tune) de-risks convergence.

**plsnet — 12 → 32 → 32 → 8, ~1.8k MAC (plsembdnn today: 1.6k).** Invoked once per pLS (Segment.h:306 slot). Inputs: signed κ from ptIn·charge, tanλ from pz/pT, cos/sin φ_c of the seed circle center, log|c|, log circleRadius, dxy, dz, log ptErr, etaErr, isQuad, charge. **IP-referencing is acceptable here by construction**: any track with a pixel seed traversed the pixel detector (vxy ≲ 15 cm) and the seed's five parameters + errors fully specify its trajectory; the displaced population that must not be origin-pinned (vxy ≥ 5 cm, no pixel seed) never enters this network. Trained jointly with t3net's embedding frozen, so pLS of track T lands near T's T3 embeddings (same trick as today's t5embdnn/plsembdnn shared space, which is proven to work for crossclean).

**tcnet — 22 → 32 → 32 → 1, ~1.7k MAC.** Invoked once per component (~10⁴/event — negligible). Inputs: nT3s, nLayers, nHits, layer-span, innermost/outermost layer index, r of first/last hit, fitted κ, tanλ, χ²_rφ/dof, χ²_rz/dof, min/mean/max accepted-edge d², centroid embedding spread, min/mean member fake score, pixel-attached flag, attached-pLS d² and seed-pT/κ consistency, and dca = | |c|−R |. dca is explicitly IP-referenced and explicitly allowed **only here**: at the final gate, with displaced-balanced training and a single auditable threshold, it lets the classifier demand more layers from large-dca candidates (fake control) without any hard prompt veto — the eff-vs-dxy curve is a release-blocking validation plot. Consumed by EmitTCs.

Total: 3 networks, 5 scalar thresholds, zero binned WP tables.

---

## 4. TIMING ARGUMENT

CPU s=1 PU200 baselines (ms): T3 66, T5 33, pT5 26, pT3 44, T4 ~10–15, TC 116; touched total ≈ 295–300. (MD 91, LS 76, pLS 334 untouched.)

- **T3′**: t3net adds ~0.5k MAC/call over t3dnn (~1.1 kFLOP × ~3–10×10⁵ calls ≈ 0.3–1.1×10⁹ FLOP; NN loops are measured to auto-vectorize at ~50 GFLOP/s effective on this EPYC). T3: 66 → ~72–90 ms.
- **K2**: 3 atomics × 1–2×10⁵ T3s + prefix ≈ 1 ms.
- **K3**: MD-matched pairs event-wide ≈ 10⁵–10⁶ (forensics: 10⁶–10⁷ visits, MD-match pass ~1/10–1/30, plus T4-pattern pairs). ~60 ops/pair → 0.6–6×10⁷ ops ≈ **2–10 ms**. Compare: these same pairs today each pay ~40 loads + 1900 MACs, twice, = the 33 ms T5 stage plus the T4 stage.
- **K4–K6**: ~3 ms. **K9**: 10⁴ comps × ~30 hits × ~60 FLOP + trig ≈ 2 ms. **K10**: rare, ~1 ms. **K12**: 10⁴ × 3.4 kFLOP ≈ 1 ms.
- **Pixel side**: plsnet ≈ plsembdnn (unchanged, inside pLS stage). K8 ≈ 0.5 ms. K11: 5×10⁴ pLS × (27 probes + ~20 cand × 30 FLOP) ≈ 3×10⁷ ≈ **3–5 ms** — replacing pT5 26 + pT3 44 + host superbin loops. No 5000/15000 caps.
- **TC stage**: the three big quadratics (RemoveDupQuintupletsBeforeTC, CrossCleanpLS, CrossCleanT4/T5) are deleted; EmitTCs is linear. 116 → ~5 ms (CheckHitspLS pass-1 stays in the pLS stage).

Touched stages: ~295 → **~90–115 ms**; event total ~460–800 → ~330–430. Uncertainty is honest at 2–3× on K3 (pair count varies per event) — even the pessimistic bound beats baseline by >2× on touched stages.

**GPU (L40, 1.9 ms/event)**: wins compound — (a) the dense-path one-block-per-module serialization (the measured critical path: ~1.6×10⁸ FLOP on one 256-thread block per hot module pair, ×2 kernels) is replaced by grid-stride flat work; (b) RemoveDupQuintupletsBeforeTC's single-thread n₁×n₂ loops (~10⁹ int ops critical path) vanish; (c) 4 host syncs go (T5 alloc, T4 alloc, 2 superbin bounces); (d) no count/create double execution for T5/T4. Union-find atomics on 10⁵ nodes are well within ECL-CC's demonstrated regime. All new kernels are portable Alpaka grid-stride or block-per-component, <1 KB shared memory, no warp intrinsics. Expect ≥30% total GPU reduction, dominated by dense events.

**Jet-core scaling (C1)**: current T5 cost = O(h⁶) scans·3 op + O(h⁵)·~4 kFLOP, ×2, serialized per module block; dedup adds O(N_T5²) ~ O(h¹⁰) with ~200 op pairs. New: O(h³)·t3net (unchanged stage) + O(h⁵)·~50 FLOP fully parallel + O(h⁵) merge/split constants. Exponent drops h⁶→h⁵ on the build, h¹⁰→h⁵ on cleanup, and the per-pair constant drops ~100×. Worked example from the forensic model (nT3=10³ both sides): one hot module pair = 1.6×10⁸ FLOP on one block today vs 4×10⁴ pairs × 50 FLOP = 2×10⁶ FLOP grid-wide — ~10²–10³× on the event critical path.

---

## 5. DISPLACED ARGUMENT (C3)

The 31.2% T3→T5 kill is dominated by t5dnn: the unconditional first cut on every MD-matched pair, with |eta₁|, |phi₁|, |z₁|, r₁ of the first hit as inputs and prompt-tuned eta-binned WPs. **That gate no longer exists.** Between T3 and TC, a displaced track now faces exactly three selections: (i) the t3net fake gate — single threshold calibrated to ≥99.5% efficiency on *track-level-matched* T3s of a displaced-enriched sample; (ii) τ_edge — a distance between embeddings built from features that are all origin-free (Sec. 3): two T3s of a displaced track agree in κ, center, tanλ exactly as well as a prompt track's, so per-edge efficiency is displacement-blind by construction; (iii) tcnet — displaced-balanced training, one threshold, eff-vs-dxy flatness as a release gate. The 8.6% T5→TC loss (tightCutFlag prompt-tuned RZ tables + crossclean casualties) is also deleted wholesale.

**pLS-less population**: components need no pixel seed and no start-region gate — today's `isValidQuintRegion` (T5 must start barrel L1/L2 or endcap L1) and the T4 region/recycling restrictions are gone. A displaced track entering at layer 3 with two MD-chained T3s becomes a 4–5-layer component; T4-pattern (shared-LS) edges are native, so today's T4 recovery object is subsumed with none of its prompt-vetoing machinery (which paradoxically *required* T4s to look displaced).

**Training strategy**: mix ≈ 45% PU200 ttbar, 25% displaced-enriched (LLP samples + displaced muon/hadron gun, vxy flat 0–40 cm), 20% high-pT dijet (jet-core hard negatives), 10% low-PU; labels are **track-level**: a T3/edge/component is signal iff matched to one sim track by majority hit fraction — directly fixing the documented plsembdnn failure (trained on object-level sim-matching mismatched to TC-level definitions, which physics χ² then outperformed). Contrastive loss for the embedding with in-jet hard negatives.

**Known limitation, stated honestly**: the module connection map (traced from IP-origin 0.8 GeV helices; removing it doubles displaced segments) still gates LS building upstream. This design removes every *downstream* origin-pinned selection; recovering map-level acceptance is a proposed addendum (retrace with a displaced+prompt mixture, bounded fanout), not a dependency — the ≥46.8% baseline is beatable on the T3-reachable population alone, where 31.2%+8.6% of today's losses occur.

---

## 6. TRACK LENGTH (C6)

Today 6–7-layer tracks exist only via ExtendT5FromDupT5 grafting one layer from an 8/10-shared-hit duplicate (capped at 40 modules, +1.4% displaced eff). In this design a duplicate T5's constituent T3s share MDs with the reference's T3s, so they land in the *same component* automatically; K9's per-layer best-hit selection then emits up to 11 layers with no cap, no CAS scoreboard, no shared-hit threshold. Every extension today's kernel can find is a subset of the component's content; length is ≥ today's by construction, and fragmentation (the one way to lose length) is measured and repaired by K6.

---

## 7. PIXEL SIDE (C4)

Superbins deleted: no 45000-bin key on IP-frame (eta_PCA, phi_PCA, dz), no 12 binary files, no 3 pixelType families, no host resolution loops. Replacement: pLS and components meet in (a) the learned 8-dim space and (b) a 32768-bucket device-built grid on origin-free helix invariants (φ_c, tanλ, signed log κ) — the quantities that agree between a pixel seed and an OT component *because they are properties of the shared helix*, valid for prompt and mildly-displaced seeds alike. Timing at scale: n_pLS = 10⁵ worst case × (27 bucket probes + ~20 candidates × 30 FLOP) ≈ 10⁸ ops ≈ 10 ms CPU serial, sub-0.1 ms GPU — comparable to or below today's pT3+pT5 70 ms, with no 5000/15000 output caps and no unmatchable-pLS map-coverage holes (the code comments this today as a known inefficiency). Unattached quad pLS remain standalone TCs exactly as today; attachment doubles as the pLS crossclean (best-per-component wins), deleting CrossCleanpLS's O(n_pLS × n_TC) pass.

---

## 8. TRAINING & DEPLOYMENT

Data: standalone `--allobj` ntuples (existing `-d` build flag machinery) over the Sec. 5 mix; a new small branch set (T3 embedding inputs, sim-track ids, component ids from a python reference clustering) — the writer infrastructure exists. Labels: track-level sim matching only. Pipeline: (1) train t3net (contrastive + fake BCE, geometric warm start); (2) freeze, dump edges/components on the training set with τ_edge scanned; (3) train plsnet into the frozen space; (4) train tcnet on realized components. Thresholds: 5 scalars, each set by a stated operating point (f_T3 and τ_edge at ≥99.5% track-level efficiency; θ_tc at baseline fake rate) — recalibration is a 5-number scan, not a 10-table re-tune. Weights ship as today's HOST_DEVICE_CONSTANT headers (same deployment path); retraining cadence tied to geometry/alignment updates, with the τ scan automated in the standalone harness (createPerfNumDenHists + lst_plot_performance comparisons).

---

## 9. RISK REGISTER

1. **Fake-T3 bridging merges two jet-core tracks.** Mitigations: κ/tanλ edge windows (origin-free, discriminating precisely where eta/phi windows are blind), per-node degree cap in K3, K10 split-by-fit. Early kill-criterion: sim-track *merge rate* in TeV dijet MC > baseline +0.5% after mitigation → escalate to a tiny edge MLP (16→16→1 on concatenated embeddings + geometric deltas) before abandoning.
2. **One global τ_edge insufficient across detector regions.** Measured first (cheapest experiment in the whole plan): edge ROC on PU200 — same-track edge efficiency at fixed fake-edge rate must be ≥99.5% (a 4-edge chain needs eff⁴ ≥ 98% to beat today's implied chain acceptance). Kill: if <99% achievable at any acceptable fake rate → condition τ on layer pair (still O(10) scalars, no eta/pt tables).
3. **Fragmentation** (missing edges split tracks → shorter TCs, C6 violation). Measured as fraction of sim tracks whose T3s span >1 component; K6 targets it. Kill: fragmentation >2% after K6 tuning → add second-hop edges (share a segment-of-segment) — bounded extra pairs.
4. **GPU perf of irregular kernels** (union-find contention, CSR builds, atomic component compaction). ECL-CC precedents at 10⁵ nodes say this is safe; kill-criterion: K2–K6 combined >0.3 ms on L40 at PU200 → replace on-the-fly union with edge-list + iterative hooking (deterministic, coalesced).
5. **Prompt regression vs a hyper-tuned baseline** (96.1% eff, current fake rate, and the pT5>pT3>T5 priority nuances encoded in crosscleans). Mitigation: phase gating (Sec. 10) with full MTV + standalone efficiency/fake/dup comparisons per phase, old path kept behind a config flag until each phase matches; tcnet gets the pixel-attached flag so it can reproduce type-priority behavior continuously rather than by cascade order. Kill per phase: any prompt eff loss >0.2% absolute or fake/dup rate increase >10% relative without a compensating displaced gain → phase does not land.

---

## 10. MIGRATION PATH

**Phase 1 — t3net drop-in.** Replace t3dnn with t3net (keep 3-class scores as auxiliary outputs so t5embdnn/t4dnn consumers still work); single fake threshold. Everything downstream untouched. Land test: T3 counts/eff (displaced T3 survival ≥ today's OR-branch), stage timing within +25 ms, full-chain physics unchanged ±0.2%. Also lands the embedding columns needed by Phase 2, and the edge-ROC measurement of Risk 2 comes free.

**Phase 2 — clustering replaces T5/T4 + OT dedup.** K2–K6, K9, K10, K12 replace CreateQuintuplets/CreateQuadruplets/Extend/all T5-T4 dedup/crossclean; components are emitted as T5-like/T4-like TCs. Pixel side untouched: pT5/pT3 still built from the superbin maps by matching pLS to a component via its innermost-module (components expose a T5-compatible view: innermost 5-layer hit set + regression circle). Land test: OT-only TC eff/fake/dup vs baseline (the C3 benchmark: displaced TC eff ≥46.8%), TC track-length distribution ≥ baseline (C6), timing of T5+T4+TC stages.

**Phase 3 — pixel head + invariant grid.** plsnet, K8, K11 replace pT5/pT3 builders, superbin maps, pt3dnn, CrossCleanpLS; delete the 5000/15000 caps. Land test: pT5-like/pT3-like eff at O(10k–100k) pLS, pixel-stage timing, jet-core TC eff where the caps used to bind.

**Phase 4 — deletion and calibration.** Remove dead code (Sec. 2 list), collapse thresholds to the final 5 scalars, enable K10 by default, ship the retraining/τ-scan harness. Land test: full C1–C6 matrix on both backends (lst_timing CPU s=1..64, GPU s=1..8; MTV 24834.703/.704), memory ≤250 MB/event (expected: lower — four object SoAs and the pixel maps are gone).

Each phase is independently revertible behind a flag, testable with the existing standalone harness, and no phase requires the collaboration to accept a physics change without a side-by-side MTV comparison.
designs.gnnLite:
# GNN-LITE EDGE CLASSIFICATION: A REPLACEMENT FOR LST FROM T3s ONWARD

Design prior: T3s become graph nodes; module-map/shared-MD adjacency becomes explicit edges; one round of lightweight learned message passing contextualizes nodes with their local density; a small MLP classifies edges; tracks are built as mutual-best paths. MD/LS/T3 building is untouched.

---

## 1. ARCHITECTURE

**Graph definition.** Nodes = accepted T3s (N_T3 ~ 1-2e5 at PU200). Two edge flavors, both already implicit in today's code:
- **E1 ("MD-chain")**: T3_i.md[2] == T3_j.md[0] — exactly the shared-middle-MD condition of `CreateQuintupletsT` (Quintuplet.h:1764). One E1 edge = a T5; a path of two E1 edges = 7 layers.
- **E2 ("LS-chain")**: T3_i.ls[1] == T3_j.ls[0] — exactly the shared-segment condition of `CreateQuadrupletsT` (Quadruplet.h:599-604). One E2 edge extends by 1 layer (T4-equivalent).

Paths in this graph are tracks of 3-9+ layers. T5, T4, the T5-extension kernel, and all T5/T4 dedup collapse into one path formalism.

**Kernel list** (all Alpaka, same source both backends; "flat" = Acc1D grid-stride, no block-per-module):

- **K1 BuildIncidence** — flat over T3s + one 1024-thread prefix-sum block (the existing `Create*ArrayRanges` pattern). Builds two CSR lists: MD -> {T3s starting there} (deg_out), MD -> {T3s ending there} (deg_in); same for LS endpoints (E2). Cost O(N_T3); O(h^3) per core module. This index is the single biggest structural change: **the shared-MD test becomes indexing, not scanning.** Today's T5 builder visits nT3(m1) x nT3(m3) = O(h^6) pairs to find the O(h^5) MD-matched ones (forensic: "the quadratic visit count is paid regardless — there is no MD->segment adjacency index"), twice (count + create kernels).
- **K2 BuildEdges** — two-pass exact allocation reusing the existing count/prefix/create machinery, but counting is pure arithmetic: E_raw = sum_MD deg_in(MD) x deg_out(MD) — no algorithm runs twice, ever (deletes the entire ReduceMem/dense double-execution pathology). Creation is a **flat edge-index decode**: thread e in [0, E_raw) binary-searches the prefix array to find its MD, decodes (i,j) = (quotient, remainder) — perfect load balance; a jet-core MD with deg 300x300 spreads over 90k threads instead of serializing onto one 256-thread block (deletes the kNTripletThreshold=1000 dense path). Per-visit work: a single loose origin-free gate — curvature-sign agreement + |1/R_i - 1/R_j| window + |tan-lambda_i - tan-lambda_j| window (~10 flops, 6 loads), thresholds set at 99.9% efficiency on prompt AND displaced sim. Writes edge records (i, j, type, 8 half-precision geometric features). Asymptotic: O(h^5) visits at 10 flops (vs today O(h^6) visits + O(h^5) x ~1900 MACs x 2 kernels).
- **K3 NodeEncoder** — flat over T3s. MLP phi_n: 12 -> 24 -> 16 (~750 MACs). Latents stored (16 x half = 32B/T3).
- **K4 MessagePass** (1 round) — flat over edges then flat over nodes. Per edge: psi(x_i, x_j, e_geo): (16+16+8) -> 8 (~320 MACs), atomically summed into target/source accumulators (on CPU serial, alpaka atomics compile to plain adds — free; on GPU, scoped float atomics). Per node: rho(x, agg_in, agg_out, deg_in, deg_out): 34 -> 16 (~550 MACs). Degree enters explicitly: **the node update sees local density**, which no per-pair cut today can.
- **K5 EdgeClassifier** — flat over edges. phi_e(x'_i, x'_j, e_geo): 40 -> 24 -> 1 sigmoid (~1000 MACs). One global threshold theta_edge.
- **K6 PathGrow** — flat over T3s, 3 sweeps. Each node selects its best-scoring surviving in-edge and out-edge; **mutual-best pairs weld**; union-find by atomicCAS pointer-jumping forms chains (max 4 T3s / 9 layers). Chain score = sum log-odds of edges + lambda_len * nLayers; accept if > theta_chain. Cost O(E_acc x sweeps), E_acc ~ 3e4. Because a T3 joins at most one chain, the 2^5-duplicate-variant explosion (one real track -> up to 32 T5s today) is collapsed structurally, not by 196-int-compare pairwise dedup.
- **K7 ChainDedup** — chains hashed into (eta, phi) cells of 0.05 AND by (first-MD, last-MD); compare only within buckets using a 6-dim projection head (linear 16 -> 6 on the pooled chain latent, ~100 MACs — the successor of t5embdnn, now nearly free) with one distance threshold theta_dup. O(N_chain x bucket occupancy), N_chain ~ 1e4.
- **K8 PixelAttach** — flat over pLS. pLS encoder (8 -> 12, once per pLS, successor of plsembdnn), candidate generation by the same (eta, phi) grid over chains + surviving single-T3 nodes above a node-score gate; cheap curvature pre-gate (5 flops), then pair head phi_px: (12+16+6) -> 16 -> 1, one threshold theta_px. An attached pLS is consumed (structural cross-clean). Replaces pT5, pT3, the superbin maps, and CrossCleanpT3/T5.
- **K9 AssembleTCs** — flat; chain+pLS -> pT5/pT3-equivalent TC, chain-only -> T5/T4-equivalent, leftover quad pLS (cleaned vs chains by the same phi_px score, threshold theta_plsTC) -> pLS TC. Positional 13-slot layer storage unchanged.

Host syncs drop from ~10 to ~4 (edge count, chain count, TC count, final check); the two host superbin-resolution loops disappear.

## 2. WHAT GETS DELETED

**Kernels**: CountTripletConnectionsT, CreateEligibleModulesListForQuintuplets, CreateQuintupletsT (both variants), ExtendT5FromDupT5, RemoveDupQuintupletsAfterBuild, RemoveDupQuintupletsBeforeTC, CountTripletLSConnectionsT, CreateEligibleModulesListForQuadruplets, CreateQuadrupletsT, RemoveDupQuadrupletsAfterBuild/BeforeTC, CreatePixelQuintupletsFromMap, CreatePixelTripletsFromMap, RemoveDupPixelQuintupletsFromMap, RemoveDupPixelTripletsFromMap, CrossCleanpT3, CrossCleanT5, CrossCleanT4, CrossCleanpLS, plus the host superbin loops (LSTEvent.dev.cc:807-877, 1077-1148).

**Physics machinery**: runQuintupletdBetaAlgoSelector + runDeltaBetaIterations (the ~20-transcendental dBeta chain incl. the kDeltaZLum beam-spot term), passT5RZConstraint + its 20-region tight/loose chi2 tables + tightCutFlag, passT4RZConstraint + 25-bin table + the dxy<0.05 anti-prompt veto, all pT5/pT3 rz/rphi chi2 region tables, PPBB/PPEE tracklet cuts, passRadiusCriterion interval tables.

**NNs (5 of 6)**: t5dnn, t4dnn, pt3dnn, t5embdnn, plsembdnn. t3dnn stays (inside the untouched T3 builder).

**WP tables (~10 -> 6 scalars)**: t5dnn kWp[2][10], t4dnn kWp_displaced/kWp_fake[2][25]x2, pt3dnn kWp_pT3[10]+kWpHigh, kWp_pT5[10]+kWpHigh, plsembdnn kWP[10]. Replaced by: theta_edge, theta_chain, lambda_len, theta_dup, theta_px, theta_plsTC.

**Maps**: all 12 pixelmap binaries, 3 pixelTypes, size_superbins=45000, PixelMap SoA, connectedPixels device array (~4-40MB).

**Caps**: n_max_pixel_triplets=5000, n_max_pixel_quintuplets=15000 (the silent jet-core efficiency cliffs), kMaxCompatModules=40, kNTripletThreshold=1000. Edge memory is exactly counted; nothing truncates in jets.

## 3. NN SPECIFICATION (4 networks, ~3.5k params total vs ~11k today)

**phi_n NodeEncoder 12 -> 24 -> 16** (per T3, in K3). Inputs, all origin-free or justified:
1-2. log10(R_circle), charge sign — 3-hit circle fit, origin-free.
3-8. (dEta_chord, dPhi, dz/kZ, dr/kR) for hit pairs (2-1),(3-2) reduced to 6 numbers: dPhi and dz/dr deltas are translation-invariant; chord-eta (eta of the hit-to-hit displacement vector, NOT of the position vector) replaces today's |eta_i| — origin-free by construction.
9. tan-lambda = dz13/ds13 (chord polar slope) — origin-free.
10-12. learned 3-dim categorical embedding of the (layer-triplet, PS/2S, barrel/endcap) module category — replaces raw |z1|, r1, |eta1|, moduleType features AND the function of every per-region chi2 table: region identity becomes an input, not 20 hand-tuned threshold sets. Detector-geometry-referenced, not track-origin-referenced: legitimate for any vertex.
Deliberately EXCLUDED: |eta1|, |phi1|, |z1|, r1 of the first hit and betaIn — the t5dnn/t3dnn IP-pinned features implicated in the 31.2% displaced kill. t3dnn scores are NOT consumed (they exist upstream but feed nothing here; ablation may re-add the displaced head only).

**psi/rho MessagePass** (K4). psi: (16+16+8) -> 8; rho: (16+8+8+2) -> 16. Edge geometric features e_geo (shared with K5, computed in K2, all origin-free): d(1/R) of the two circle fits; bridge-circle radius through the 3 MDs spanning the junction (the origin-free part of today's T5 input set); circle-center distance / mean radius (the origin-free analog of pT5's rPhiChiSquared); d(tan-lambda); junction dPhi kink; shared-MD module category; edge type (E1/E2); layer-gap count.

**phi_e EdgeClassifier (16+16+8) -> 24 -> 1 sigmoid** (K5). Output consumed by PathGrow (K6) and, accumulated as log-odds, by chain acceptance. Single global WP.

**phi_px PixelAttach**: pLS encoder 8 -> 12 (1/ptIn, ptErr/ptIn, eta, sin phi, cos phi, tan-lambda, isQuad, log10 circleRadius) + pair head (12+16+6 geo) -> 16 -> 1. The pLS features are 100% IP-referenced and that is acceptable here: a pixel seed is by construction an IP-region object (4 hits inside r~16cm fitted with beamline constraint); displaced tracks at vxy>=5cm largely have no pLS and their path to a TC (chains) never touches this network. Invoked once per pLS (encoder) and per candidate pair (head).

**DupHead**: linear 16 -> 6 projection (part of phi_n's training graph, not a separate net), trained contrastively with track-level labels; used only in K7/K9.

## 4. TIMING ARGUMENT

Calibration: the T5 stage runs at 33 ms CPU s=1 including count+create+extend+dedup; at a realistic 30-50 GFLOP/s single-thread for these vectorized MLPs (the study confirms zmm auto-vectorization of NN loops), 33 ms bounds t5dnn evaluations to ~2-5e5/event — so E (gated edges) ~ 3-5e5 typical, ~2e6 in a pathological event. Arithmetic at E=5e5, N_T3=1.5e5, N_pLS=1e5, 40 GFLOP/s CPU:

| Kernel | Ops | CPU est | 
|---|---|---|
| K1 incidence | O(N_T3) int | ~2 ms |
| K2 edge enum+gate | ~1.5e6 visits x 10 flops + 5e5 writes | ~4 ms |
| K3 node enc | 1.5e5 x 750 MACs = 2.2e8 flop | ~6 ms |
| K4 message (1 round) | 5e5x320 + 1.5e5x550 = 5e8 flop | ~12 ms |
| K5 edge classify | 5e5 x 1000 MACs = 1e9 flop | ~25 ms |
| K6 path grow | 3 x 3e4 edges | ~2 ms |
| K7 chain dedup | ~1e5 bucketed pairs x 200 ops | ~2 ms |
| K8 pixel attach | 1e5 pLS x ~20 cand x (5-flop pregate; ~20% pay 700 MACs) | ~10 ms |
| K9 assemble | O(TC) | ~2 ms |
| **Total** | | **~65 ms** |

Replaced baseline: T5 33 + T4 ~15 + pT5 26 + pT3 44 + TC 116 = ~235 ms, plus the plsembdnn part of pLS ingestion. Even at 2x contingency (~130 ms) the design beats baseline; at 4x it breaks even. Honest uncertainties: E could be 2-3x higher than calibrated (K5 scales linearly: +50 ms worst); atomics in K4 are free on CPU but unmodeled overheads (cache misses on CSR indirection) could add 30-50%.

**Degraded variant if needed** (saves K3/K4, ~18 ms): replace learned messages with aggregate statistics computed during K2 at ~5 flops/edge into per-node atomic accumulators — deg_in, deg_out, mean/min neighbor d(1/R), sum of gate margins — appended as 6 scalars to phi_e's input. Keeps the first-order density signal (degree and consistency statistics), loses learned relational features; expected to give up part of the in-core fake rejection, none of the displaced physics.

**GPU (L40, s=8, baseline 1.9 ms/event)**: every kernel is flat, coalesced, and load-balanced by construction. The two current GPU pathologies vanish: (a) the dense path serializing ~6e5 serial flops/thread onto one 256-thread block per hot module (the event critical path per the forensics) — K2/K5 spread the same jet over the whole device; (b) ~10 stream-draining host syncs -> 4. Dominant compute K5 = 1e9 flop ~ 0.05 ms at even 20 TFLOP/s effective; the stage becomes memory/atomic bound, well under the ~1 ms the replaced stages consume today. Shared memory use: none required beyond block accumulators (<1KB), far under 48KB.

**Jet-core scaling (C1)**, per core module chain in hit multiplicity h: today, T5 visits O(h^6) x 3 ops + O(h^5) x ~1900 MACs (unconditional t5dnn) x 2 kernels, serialized on one block, then O(N_T5^2) dedup (~1e9 int ops, single-thread chunks). New: exact enumeration O(h^5) x 10 flops, survivors x ~2000 MACs once, fully parallel, then O(E_core) welding. The exponent drops 6 -> 5, the constant on the h^5 term drops ~200x for gate-rejected pairs, the double execution disappears, and the dedup quadratic disappears (mutual-best is linear in edges). In-cone discrimination: today "only in-cone discriminators are hit-index compares and 6-dim embedding distance" (all eta/phi windows 0.1-0.5 pass everything at DR<0.05); the edge classifier instead sees neighborhood context — a fake edge joining T3s of two different tracks has in/out aggregates that corroborate different helices (inconsistent d(1/R), tan-lambda statistics), a signal that per-pair chi2+DNN structurally cannot access.

## 5. DISPLACED ARGUMENT (C3)

- **The 31.2% T3->T5 kill** is the t5dnn gate: first, unconditional, with |eta1|,|phi1|,|z1|,r1 raw IP-frame inputs and WPs tuned on prompt-dominated PU200. In this design that gate does not exist. Its successor (phi_e) has zero raw global coordinates on the critical path: every input is a chord, curvature, or two-circle-consistency quantity, invariant under displacement of the track origin. The dBeta cuts (explicit kDeltaZLum beam-spot term), the prompt-tuned RZ region tables, and betaIn are deleted, not retuned.
- **pLS-less T5/T4 population** (the dominant high-displacement population): chains are pixel-free objects; 4-layer (single E2) chains through 9-layer chains are treated by one uniform score. The T4 stage's displaced-only classification and dxy anti-prompt veto — hacks to keep a leftover-object class fake-clean — are replaced by chain-score acceptance with the length term lambda_len, which naturally demands more evidence from shorter chains without forbidding prompt 4-layer tracks.
- **Training mix and labels**: edges labeled at TRACK level — positive iff both T3s are MD-matched (>=2 of 3 MDs each) to the SAME sim track; dedup pairs labeled by same-sim-track under the MTV 75% TC criterion. This fixes the documented plsembdnn failure (trained on object-level sim-matching mismatched to TC-level dup definitions, to the point that physics chi2 beat it for pT5 crossclean). Sample: PU200 RelVal (~200 events, O(1e8) edge candidates) + displaced-enriched gun (production vertex flat in r in [0, 30] cm, both muons and hadronic) oversampled so displaced tracks contribute >=25% of positive edges; loss reweighted for efficiency parity between the populations, with a single WP — parity is enforced in training, not by per-population thresholds.
- **Why >= today, mechanistically**: today's pipeline uses IP-pointing as its principal fake discriminator, so removing it for displaced tracks costs fake rejection, which the WP tables then buy back by killing displaced efficiency. This design substitutes two origin-free discriminators — multi-object consistency (edge geometry) and local-density context (messages) — so the fake/displaced trade is no longer forced. The 8.6% T5->TC loss (dedup/crossclean cascade with its prompt-blind tiebreaks) is also restructured: chains cannot lose priority fights against pixel-seeded types because attachment, not priority ordering, resolves overlap.
- Known ceiling honestly stated: the module connection map (traced from IP-origin 0.8 GeV helices, gating LS building) remains the upstream acceptance limit; a phase-4 addendum (map union with displaced-helix tracing) is proposed but the design does not depend on it.

## 6. TRACK LENGTH (C6)

6-7+ layer tracks are first-class: a chain of 2 E1 edges = 7 layers, E1+E2 = 6, capped at 9. Today's ExtendT5FromDupT5 reaches 6-7 layers only by grafting hits from near-duplicate T5s (+1.4% displaced eff) — an O(N_T5^2) post-hoc repair with a 40-module cap. Here the same physical evidence (multiple overlapping T3s along one track) is consumed as alternative path segments: PathGrow's chain score prefers longer paths via lambda_len, and mutual-best selection picks the best hit variant per junction. Truncation risk (greedy misses the long path) is handled by 3 sweeps with second-best fallback and is an explicit phase-2 metric: recovered-path length distribution vs the T5+extension baseline.

## 7. PIXEL SIDE (C4)

The 45000-superbin, 12-file, 3-pixelType map machinery is deleted, including its host round-trips executed twice per event and its documented coverage holes ("a significant fraction of unmatchable pLSs"). Replacement: chains and gated single-T3 nodes are bucketed once into a 0.05 x 0.05 (eta, phi) grid (~12.5k cells, O(N_chain) build). Each pLS queries 3x3 cells. Arithmetic at 1e5 pLS: targets = ~1e4 chains + ~2e4 gated free T3s -> ~2.4/cell -> ~22 candidates/pLS -> 2.2e6 pairs; the 5-flop curvature pre-gate (|1/pT_seed - 1/pT_target| window) passes ~20%; ~4.4e5 pair-head evaluations x 700 MACs = 6e8 flop = ~10-15 ms CPU vs 70 ms today (pT3+pT5). At 1e4 pLS: ~1.5 ms. Jet core: ~50 pLS x ~30 in-cone targets = 1.5e3 pairs/jet — the O(jet-density^2) pLS-x-hot-module product survives but with a ~700-MAC constant on a 20% subset instead of full tracklet+chi2+DNN chains, and no global 5000/15000 caps to overflow. GPU: flat pLS-major kernel, no host mapping loop.

## 8. TRAINING & DEPLOYMENT

- **Data**: extend the standalone `--allobj` ntuple with edge dumps (T3 index pairs from K1/K2 logic run on CPU, e_geo features, sim-match labels) — one new writer, no kernel dependency. Training in PyTorch; the whole model is ~3.5k params, trains in minutes; end-to-end (phi_n, psi, rho, phi_e, DupHead) with edge BCE + auxiliary node BCE + contrastive dedup loss.
- **Labels**: as in section 5 — track-level throughout; no object-level labels anywhere.
- **WP collapse**: 6 scalar thresholds, each set by one efficiency target on a validation split (theta_edge: 99.5% per-edge displaced-positive eff; theta_chain/lambda_len: fake-rate match to baseline TCs; theta_dup: 99th-pct true-dup distance, as today but on track-level labels; theta_px/theta_plsTC: current pT5-WP-style 99.5% targets). Eta/pt dependence is absorbed by the learned features (module-category embedding + curvature inputs); if residual eta bias appears, the mitigation is a learned per-node threshold head, never tables.
- **Deployment**: weights exported to one generated `GNNWeights.h` of HOST_DEVICE_CONSTANT arrays (existing pattern), version-tagged. Retraining triggers: geometry/alignment change, ptCut change, or DQM drift alarms on the edge-score distribution (persisted per run). Calibration-only refresh (thresholds, not weights) is a one-file constant change.

## 9. RISK REGISTER

1. **Prompt fake rejection without the IP prior falls short** -> more fake TCs at fixed eff. Mitigation: optional 2nd message round (+12 ms CPU, still in budget); add bridge-circle chi2 to e_geo. Kill criterion (phase 1, pure offline): on frozen T3 inputs, phi_e must achieve fake rate <= 1.2x t5dnn's at t5dnn's own prompt efficiency point AND >= 1.5x displaced efficiency at equal fake; measurable before any kernel is written.
2. **Mutual-best welding truncates or breaks tracks in cores.** Mitigation: 3 sweeps + second-best fallback; chain score prefers length. Kill criterion: sim-track path-recovery rate (>=5-layer sim tracks whose full chain is found) below the T5+ExtendT5 baseline on the displaced sample in the phase-2 emulator.
3. **Edge count blow-up beyond calibration** (E >> 5e5 in extreme events) -> K5 linear cost breaks CPU budget. Mitigation: the K2 gate thresholds are the single tunable lever (tighten to 99.5% eff recovers ~2x); degraded variant saves 18 ms; K5 can run on gate-margin-sorted edges with early-out. Kill criterion: measured E > 2e6 on >1% of PU200 events at 99.9% gate eff.
4. **GPU atomic contention on hot MDs/nodes** in K1/K4. Mitigation: warp-aggregated atomics; block-local staging (a 256-node tile of 16-half latents = 8KB << 48KB shared). Kill criterion: K4 kernel time > 2x roofline projection on a top-quark+jet skim.
5. **Hash-bucketed dedup misses duplicates** whose chains differ in every bucket key -> dup rate up. Mitigation: dual keying ((eta,phi) cell AND first/last MD), neighbor-cell widening, exact fallback restricted to jet cones (bounded N). Kill criterion: TC duplicate rate > 1.2x baseline on PU200.

## 10. MIGRATION PATH

- **Phase 1 — offline proof (no C++ changes)**: edge-dump writer in the standalone ntupler; train the model; replay-emulate edge decisions vs t5dnn/t4dnn on identical T3 inputs; evaluate risk-1/risk-2 kill criteria, displaced (vxy>=5cm) edge efficiency, and the E-count calibration. Deliverable: go/no-go with measured ROC and edge counts.
- **Phase 2 — chain builder behind a flag**: land K1-K7 as an alternative path to createQuintuplets+createQuadruplets+ExtendT5+RemoveDup*; chains are emitted as today's T5/T4 SoA objects (chains truncated to 7 layers fill the existing 7-slot layout; E2-only chains fill QuadrupletsSoA) so pT5/pT3/TC code runs unchanged. A/B in standalone: per-stage timing (target: T5+T4+T5-dedup portions <= 48 ms replaced by <= 30 ms), MTV efficiency/fake/dup on both backends. Independently revertable.
- **Phase 3 — pixel attach**: land K8/K9; retire superbin maps, pT5/pT3 builders, and the CrossClean cascade for pixel-vs-chain overlap (attachment consumes pLS). The 5000/15000 caps die here. A/B: pT5/pT3-equivalent efficiency, jet-core TC efficiency (where the caps currently truncate), pLS-stage timing.
- **Phase 4 — cleanup + addenda**: delete dead kernels/tables/weight headers; collapse TC assembly to the 3-type scheme; propose (separately reviewable) t3dnn WP relaxation now that downstream context absorbs fakes, and the displaced-traced module-map union as the remaining upstream displaced-acceptance fix.

Each phase is testable against `lst_timing` and `lst_plot_performance.py --compare` baselines and lands without touching MD/LS/T3 builders.

This one kernel subsumes RemoveDupQuintuplets{AfterBuild,BeforeTC}, RemoveDupQuadruplets{AfterBuild,BeforeTC}, RemoveDupPixelTriplets/QuintupletsFromMap, CrossClean{pT3,T5,T4,pLS}, CheckHitspLS pass 2, and ExtendT5FromDupT5. Work is flat-parallelized pairs — no single-thread n1 x n2 chunks (Kernels.h:530-540).
- K15 CountSurvivingTCs + one templated AddTrackCandidates: as today, minus tightCutFlag gating (deleted; the UCS threshold replaces it).

Host syncs drop from ~10 to ~6 (T3 alloc, pair buffer, chain alloc, attach alloc, TC alloc, final check). pLS ingestion keeps: eta-sorted pass-1 pLS dedup (proven 5x speedup), UE replacing plsembdnn at equal cost.

2. WHAT GETS DELETED

Kernels: CountTripletConnectionsT, CreateQuintupletsT (both dense-inline and sparse-staging variants), CreateEligibleModulesListForQuintuplets, CountTripletLSConnectionsT, CreateQuadrupletsT, CreateEligibleModulesListForQuadruplets, ExtendT5FromDupT5, RemoveDupQuintupletsAfterBuild, RemoveDupQuintupletsBeforeTC, RemoveDupQuadrupletsAfterBuild, RemoveDupQuadrupletsBeforeTC, RemoveDupPixelTripletsFromMap, RemoveDupPixelQuintupletsFromMap, CrossCleanpT3, CrossCleanT5, CrossCleanT4, CrossCleanpLS, CheckHitspLS second pass, CreatePixelTripletsFromMap, CreatePixelQuintupletsFromMap, both host superbin-resolution loops, AddT5/AddT4/AddpT5/AddpT3 collapse to one templated adder.
NNs: t3dnn, t5dnn, t4dnn, pt3dnn, t5embdnn, plsembdnn (6 weight headers) -> 2 (UCS, UE).
WP tables (all deleted): t3 kWp_prompt/kWp_displaced (2x2x10), t5 kWp (2x10), t4 kWp_displaced/kWp_fake (2x2x25), pt3 kWp_pT3/kWpHigh_pT3/kWp_pT5/kWpHigh_pT5 (22 numbers), plsembdnn kWP (10). Replaced by 3 UCS thresholds + 4 UE distance thresholds (t_pair, t_dup, t_attach, t_cross).
Heuristic machinery: runQuintupletdBetaAlgoSelector + runDeltaBetaIterations (both T5 invocations and the T4 pT-windowed one, including the explicit kDeltaZLum beam-spot terms), PPBB/PPEE pixel-tracklet algos, T5 RZ 20-region tight/loose threshold tables + tightCutFlag, T4 25-bin chi2 table, T4 dxy anti-prompt veto, pT3/pT5 rz/rphi/inwards chi2 threshold tables (the chi2 COMPUTATIONS survive as NN features), score_rphisum ranking, isDup bitmask semantics.
Maps/caps: 12 pixelmap .bin files, PixelMap/getConnectedPixels, superbin + pixelType columns and the 2 GeV/±2.6/±30cm binning constants; n_max_pixel_triplets=5000, n_max_pixel_quintuplets=15000, kMaxCompatModules=40, kNTripletThreshold=1000; preAllocatedSegmentIndices/preAllocatedTripletIndices scratch columns.
Kept unchanged: MD/LS builders, T3 pointing constraint and T3 RZ (upstream, as-is), count->prefix->allocate pattern, partOf flags, packed-CAS best-per-layer, positional TC layer storage, eta-sorted pLS pass-1 dedup. Addendum (out of design scope, flagged as residual limitation): the IP-traced module connection map and the T3 pointing constraint remain the upstream displaced-acceptance bound; a displaced-augmented map retrace is the natural follow-up.

3. NN SPECIFICATION

Net 1 — Unified Chain Scorer (UCS). Shared trunk ~40 inputs -> 32 (ReLU) -> 32 (ReLU), three heads 32->1 (sigmoid): T3 head, chain head (serves nLayers 4-7, replacing t5dnn+t4dnn), pixel-attach head (replacing pt3dnn's two WP uses; a 10-input seed-feature adapter concatenates into layer 2). ~2.4k MACs/call — same budget class as today, but invoked last, on prefilter survivors only.
Inputs, 7 layer slots with presence mask (T3 = 3 slots filled):
- Detector-element context (origin-free by nature — they describe where the measurement happened and its resolution, equally defined for displaced hits): per-slot logicalLayer/11, moduleType (PS/2S), barrel/endcap flag; r_first/kR_max, |z_first|/kZ_max.
- Origin-free track geometry (discrete Frenet encoding): per consecutive anchor pair, transverse step length s_i, dz_i, and turning angle psi_i encoded as normalized (cross, dot) of consecutive step vectors — fully translation- and rotation-invariant; local dip dz_1/s_1 replaces eta1 (eta1 is a track-direction proxy only for prompt tracks — the identified mechanism of the 31.2% displaced kill); |phi1| is dropped outright (pure symmetry coordinate).
- Curvatures 1/R_inner, 1/R_bridge, 1/R_outer, 1/R_regression (3/5-hit fits, origin-free); own-helix r-z chi2 and r-phi regression chi2 (helix seeded from the chain's own circle fit, no vertex term — origin-free).
- Pixel-attach adapter (IP-referenced, justified): ptIn, ptErr, etaErr, isQuad, delta(1/R) seed-vs-chain, seed-propagated r-z and r-phi chi2. A pLS exists only because the IP-constrained pixel seeder produced it; attaching it is intrinsically an IP-frame operation and displaced tracks without pixel seeds never enter this head.
Consumers: T3 head gates T3 build (in K3); chain head gates K8/K8'; attach head gates K12; the chain-head score S is the single quality used in K14 ranking.

Net 2 — Unified Embedder (UE). Shared geometry encoder (same origin-free feature block, padded) -> 32 -> 32 -> 6 linear; a separate 10->32 pLS input adapter (seed parameters, same justification) feeds the shared tail so T3s, chains, and pLS land in ONE metric space. ~2.2k MACs/call, invoked once per accepted object (N_T3 + N_chain + N_pLS ~ 2e5/event). Consumers: K5 pair prefilter (t_pair), K12 attach prefilter (t_attach), K13/K14 bucketing + duplicate test (t_dup), pLS-vs-chain resolution (t_cross). Trained with track-level contrastive labels (same-sim-track objects attract across types), fixing the documented object-level/TC-level mismatch that made physics chi2 beat plsembdnn for pT5 crossclean.

4. TIMING ARGUMENT

CPU s=1 PU200 baselines: MD 91 / LS 76 / T3 66 / T5 33 / pLS 334 / pT5 26 / pT3 44 / TC 116 ms.
- T3: builder unchanged; UCS-T3 head is the same size class as t3dnn (2.4k vs 1.6k MACs) on the same call count; UE adds ~1e5 accepted-T3 calls x 4.4 kFLOP ~ 4.4e8 FLOPs ~ +8-15 ms with the already-demonstrated vectorized MLP throughput. T3: 66 -> ~75-80 ms (an explicit tax, repaid below).
- Chains vs T5+T4 (33 + T4 stage): today the create+count kernels SCAN nT3(m1)xnT3(m3) and pay ~40 loads + ~1900 MACs on every MD-matched pair as the FIRST cut, twice in dense/ReduceMem. New: CSR emits only matched pairs (~1e6 event-wide) at ~25 ops each (2.5e7 ops for K5+K7), and the ~5 kFLOP full evaluation runs once on the prefilter survivors. At an assumed 3-10x prefilter rejection (the key uncertainty — see risks), NN+fit work is 1-3e5 x 5 kFLOP ~ 0.5-1.5e9 FLOPs vs today's 4e9-4e10 dominated by t5dnn-first. dBeta (~15-20 transcendentals/survivor x 2 invocations) is deleted. Estimate: 15-25 ms for both chain passes combined, vs 33 + T4.
- Jet-core exponent (C1): current cost per hot module pair = h^6 scan visits x 3 ops + h^5 x ~2000 FLOPs unconditional, x2 kernels, serialized on ONE 256-thread block (measured event critical path); concrete study number: nT3=1e3 both sides -> ~3.2e8 FLOPs on one block. New: h^5 visits x ~25 ops + f_pre·h^5 x 5 kFLOP, flat over the whole device: same case -> 4e4 matched x 25 = 1e6 ops + ~4e7 FLOPs event-distributed: ~400x less work on the critical path, and the scan exponent drops 6 -> 5. Dedup in-cone drops from O(N_jet^2) x ~200 int ops on single threads (~1e9 op critical path) to embedding-bucketed pairs x 12-FLOP d2, flat-parallel: ~1e6-1e7 ops.
- Pixel attach vs pT5+pT3 (70 ms): pair count is comparable to the map's (window ~ superbin granularity; 1e6-1e7 pairs) but the per-pair prefix is ~20 ops (curvature + d2) instead of entering PPBB/PPEE; chi2+NN only on survivors (~1e5 x 3 kFLOP ~ 3e8 FLOPs). The two serial host map-resolution loops disappear. Estimate 30-50 ms.
- Overlap+TC vs 116 ms (+ in-stage dedup ~40-80 ms elsewhere): ~1e5 candidates, bucketed pairs ~5e6 x ~30 ops = 1.5e8 ops flat -> ~25-45 ms including grafting, vs the current cascade's 150-200 ms aggregate.
- pLS 334 ms is dominated by O(n^2) dedup already fixed elsewhere (proven 318->64 ms); UE swap is cost-neutral vs plsembdnn. Book 90-110 ms.
Total CPU estimate: 91+76+78+20+100+40+35 ~ 440 ms vs ~660-786 today — comfortably within C5 even if the chain and attach estimates are 2x pessimistic, because the deleted double-executions and dBeta chains alone are guaranteed wins.
GPU (1.9 ms/event, s=8): gains are structural — the dense-block serialization (the stated critical path) is gone; t5dnn-first FLOPs (the dominant 4e9-4e10) drop ~10x; 4 host round-trips removed; dedup single-thread chunks flattened. Costs: ~10 extra small kernel launches (~0.05-0.1 ms) and atomic traffic on CSR builds (bounded, O(N) atomics). Estimate 1.2-1.6 ms. Honest uncertainties: f_pre (curvature/charge/embed rejection at fixed 99.9% signal eff) is unmeasured; CSR bucket-degree variance may cause K5 imbalance (mitigable by splitting high-degree T3s across threads); embedding-cell bucketing quality pre-retraining is unproven (eta-phi fallback retains most of the win: pairs still flat-parallelized).

5. DISPLACED ARGUMENT

The 31.2% T3->T5 kill is attacked at its three documented sources: (i) t5dnn's IP-referenced inputs (|eta1|,|phi1|,|z1|,r1 raw, prompt-trained WPs) — replaced by the origin-free Frenet/curvature/detector-context feature set where hit-position eta/phi (track-direction proxies valid only for prompt tracks) simply do not exist; (ii) the dBeta cuts with explicit kDeltaZLum beam-spot terms — deleted outright; (iii) prompt-tuned RZ/chi2 threshold tables — demoted from cuts to features, letting the scorer trade r-z consistency against everything else per candidate instead of applying prompt-derived hard walls. Nothing on the OT-only critical path (enumeration = topology; prefilters = charge/curvature from 3-hit fits + UE distance over origin-free features) references the origin. The T5->TC 8.6% loss channels (tightCutFlag's 95%-eff prompt-tuned RZ gate, prompt-biased dedup ranking) are deleted/replaced by the single displaced-aware score S.
The pLS-less population: 4-layer recovery chains use the same builder/scorer (replacing T4s, whose displaced role is preserved: leftover-T3-only, same region gates), and native extension + graft-on-merge lengthen them; overlap resolution prefers longer chains, so the highest-displacement T5/T4 population competes on nLayers and S, not on prompt-tuned rphisum.
Training strategy: PU200(RelVal) + displaced-enriched samples (displaced-muon gun and long-lived-particle decays spanning vxy 1-40 cm), positives reweighted to ~30-50% displaced; LABELS ARE TRACK-LEVEL (>=75% of candidate hits from one sim track; duplicates = two candidates matched to the same sim track) for both networks — the same definition used by the TC-level performance metric, fixing the known object-level training mismatch. Thresholds are calibrated to hold displaced efficiency >= the baseline 46.8% as a hard constraint with fake rate as the objective, and the T3-head keeps an effective displaced-OR acceptance via multi-task training. Residual honesty: the module map and T3 pointing constraint still bound displaced acceptance upstream; this design removes every downstream origin-pinned cut, which is where the measured 31.2%+8.6% losses live.

6. TRACK LENGTH

Three mechanisms, two of them proven patterns: (i) K9 native extension attaches 6th/7th layers directly from the LS CSR at chain endpoints (both directions), using the atomic-nLayers slot machinery already validated by ExtendT5FromDupT5; (ii) K14 grafts the unmatched layer of a killed duplicate onto the winner — exactly today's +1.4%-displaced merge mechanism, relocated into the pass that already inspects the pair; (iii) the overlap winner key ranks nLayers first, so longer tracks systematically survive. Net: >= today's 6-7-layer yield, with (i) additionally reaching tracks whose extension layer never formed a duplicate T5 (today's mechanism requires one).

7. PIXEL SIDE

The 45000-superbin/12-file/3-pixelType map is replaced by per-event device-side geometry: propagate each pLS's own stored helix to the L1/L2 attach surfaces, open a window sized by ptErr + multiple scattering, and query a ~32x72 (eta,phi) CSR grid of chains and free T3s built in O(N) — the map's tabulated helix tracing done analytically, with exact dz and continuous curvature (no 2 GeV pixelType boundary). Timing at O(10k-100k) pLS: grid build ~1e5 atomics; window occupancy ~1-30 objects -> 1e6-3e6 pairs (comparable to the map's pair count) x ~20-op prefix (curvature-interval + 12-FLOP UE d2) ~ 2-6e7 ops; survivors (~1e5) pay chi2 + 3 kFLOP NN ~ 3-4e8 FLOPs ~ 10-15 ms CPU; well under the 70 ms baseline even before subtracting the deleted host loops. At the 100k-pLS extreme the cost scales linearly in pLS (unlike CheckHitspLS's quadratic, which remains bounded by the eta-sorted pass-1). Dynamic count-based allocation replaces the 5000/15000 caps, removing the silent jet-core truncation cliff.

8. TRAINING & DEPLOYMENT

Pipeline: standalone `-d`/`--allobj` ntuples extended to dump prefilter-survivor candidates (not just accepted objects) so the scorer trains on exactly its inference-time input distribution; samples = PU200RelVal + displaced-enriched as in section 5. One training repo, one label module (track-level matching + same-track duplicate pairs), two networks, weights exported to two compiled headers by the existing script pattern. WP collapse: after training, a per-(eta,pt)-bin quantile map of the score is fitted automatically and folded into a monotone piecewise-linear output calibration compiled into the head — the eta-dependence moves inside the calibrated score, leaving 3 scalar score thresholds + 4 embedding-distance thresholds (each auto-set as a quantile of the true-pair distance distribution, the method already used for d2Thresh=0.25). Retraining is a single automated run (train -> calibrate -> export -> standalone validation gate); no hand-tuned tables remain.

9. RISK REGISTER

R1 Cheap prefilters reject too little (f_pre < 2x at 99.9% displaced+prompt signal eff), so NN-last saves nothing. Early measurement: instrument K5 pass fractions on PU200 + high-pT dijet before any NN work (Phase 1 uses existing NNs). Kill: f_pre < 2 -> keep CSR + flat evaluation (still the h^6->h^5 and load-balance win), drop only the reorder claim.
R2 Retrained origin-free embedding loses in-cone duplicate discrimination (current one leans on IP features + T3 scores). Measure: in-cone true-dup vs distinct-track d2 separation (AUC) vs current embedding on jet events, before deleting any kernel. Kill: AUC regression -> widen to 8 dims / add residual features; eta-phi bucketing fallback caps the dedup risk meanwhile.
R3 Single calibrated thresholds cause efficiency ripple vs today's binned WPs. Measure: eff vs eta/pt flatness in Phase 2 validation. Kill: ripple > 2% absolute -> retain the piecewise-linear calibration with more knots (still O(10) constants, not 10 tables).
R4 Deleting dBeta/chi2 hard cuts admits fakes the scorer misses, indirectly hurting displaced via overlap resolution. Measure: Phase 2 A/B cut-flow (fake rate at matched displaced+prompt eff); hard gate: displaced TC eff >= 46.8% AND fake <= baseline, else re-tighten via calibration before landing.
R5 4-layer chains (T4 replacement) fake blowup without the dxy anti-prompt veto. Measure: T4-class fake rate and TC contamination vs baseline. Mitigation: leftover-only + region gates are retained; kill criterion fake > 1.2x baseline -> reinstate a learned prompt-suppression term (the chain head's features suffice to emulate dxy) rather than the geometric veto.

10. MIGRATION PATH

Phase 1 (pure engineering, physics-identical): K4 CSR + K5-K8 pair-queue evaluation for T5 (then T4), count pass = cheap existing prefix (MD topology via CSR + existing charge compare), full existing selection (t5dnn, dBeta, RZ) run once in K8 — the selection is a pure AND, so reordering is output-identical; deletes kNTripletThreshold and the double execution. Validated by object-count identity + lst_timing on both backends. Independently landable.
Phase 2 (NN unification): train UCS+UE with track-level displaced-aware labels; swap 6 nets -> 2; delete dBeta chains, chi2/WP tables, tightCutFlag; dedup cascade structure untouched but driven by S and the new embedding. Gated by the R2/R3/R4 criteria on the standalone perf harness (displaced categories) + MTV workflows.
Phase 3 (pixel grid): K10-K12 replace superbin maps and the pT3/pT5 builders; dynamic allocation replaces the 5000/15000 caps. Validated on pT3/pT5 eff/fake parity + jet-core truncation counts + timing.
Phase 4 (overlap unification + native extension): K9 + K13/K14 replace the Extend/RemoveDup/CrossClean cascade and fold T4 into the chain object. Validated on duplicate rate, track length distribution (C6: 6-7-layer yield >= baseline), displaced eff, and the TC-stage timing.
Each phase is a standalone PR series testable against the current baseline with the existing createPerfNumDenHists/lst_plot_performance and lst_timing tooling; no phase depends on a later one for correctness.

# SEED-CENTRIC LEARNED TRACK FOLLOWING: LST replacement design from T3s onward

## 1. ARCHITECTURE

**Inversion.** Today, T5/T4 building enumerates all inner-T3 x outer-T3 pairs per module (O(h^6) visits per module pair in core hit multiplicity h; Quintuplet.h:1748-1765), pays a ~40-load/~1900-MAC t5dnn prefix on every MD-matched pair before the first cut can fire, runs everything twice (count + create), then spends O(N_T5^2) again un-duplicating what over-enumeration created (RemoveDupQuintupletsBeforeTC, ~1e9 ops critical path). The replacement builds each track exactly once: every seed extends itself layer-by-layer through the existing LS graph, a learned proposal head ranks the few continuations, a beam of width B=2 keeps alternatives, and a learned stop/accept head terminates. Duplicates are prevented structurally (one track per seed) and residual redundancy is resolved in one hit-claim arbitration pass over ~10^4 objects, not ~10^5.

MD/LS/T3 building, including t3dnn, is unchanged. Notation: N_LS, N_T3 event totals; h = core hit multiplicity per module; S = max follow steps (9, logical layers 1-11); B = beam width (2).

**K1. BuildLSAdjacency.** Builds two CSR indices over existing LSs: MD -> outgoing LSs (keyed by inner MD) and MD -> incoming LSs (keyed by outer MD). Count (atomicAdd per LS), single-block prefix sum (same pattern as CreateMDArrayRangesGPU), fill. Shape: grid-stride, one thread per LS. Cost O(N_LS) ~ 1e6 ops; removes the "no MD->segment adjacency index" defect the forensics identified as the reason T3 pairing is quadratic-scanned. Jet-core cost: linear in local LS count, O(h^2) total (the LSs already exist; we only index them).

**K2. SelectSeeds.** Two seed lists from surviving T3s: Wave-1 = T3s whose innermost module is in today's T5-start region (barrel L1/L2, endcap L1; isValidQuintRegion); Wave-2 = T3s in today's T4 region (barrel L>2, any endcap) — the late-entry/displaced population. Seeds sorted by (start layer asc, 1 - t3 fakeScore desc) with a device radix sort for determinism and warp coherence. Shape: one thread per T3. Cost O(N_T3 log N_T3), trivial.

**K3. FollowSeeds (Wave 1).** The core kernel. Shape: one warp (GPU) / one block (CPU serial, where the 32 "threads" become sequential elements via uniform_elements — same Alpaka source) per seed; grid = seed count; persistent beam state in shared memory (<1 KB per seed: 2 x {9 running circle/line-fit accumulators, tanLambda, hit list of 18 indices, per-step score stats} — far under the 48 KB budget). Per step, from each beam element's current outer MD:

- enumerate outgoing LSs from the K1 CSR (candidates = deg(MD), typically 2-6, up to ~f*h in a jet core);
- cheap residual pregate (~10 FLOPs): propagate the running circle+line fit one layer and cut on curvature-corrected local dphi and dz/dr residuals against a wide, learned-quantile window. Critically, this is a *local residual to the candidate's own propagated helix*, not an eta/phi window: in a DR<0.05 core the transverse track spread at r=50 cm is ~2.5 cm while propagation residuals are ~0.1-1 mm, so this gate keeps its power exactly where every current 0.1-0.5 eta/phi window passes everything (forensic fact: only in-cone discriminators today are hit compares and embed distance);
- ExtendNet (Section 3) scores survivors; warp threads score candidates in parallel, warp reduction keeps top-B;
- incremental fit update: adding a hit updates the 9 algebraic circle-regression accumulators (the same math as computeRadiusUsingRegression, made incremental, O(1) per hit) and the r-z line fit; no per-step transcendentals beyond one sincos-free rotation;
- stop when no candidate clears theta_extend or S reached. Then extend *inward* from the innermost MD via the incoming-LS CSR (same code, mirrored) — this is what makes late-entry displaced tracks and maximum track length natural. TrackNet accept head runs once per seed on the pooled summary; the best beam branch above theta_accept(nLayers) is written to the Tracks SoA (<=1 track per seed, so allocation = nSeeds, known after the T3 stage — no new host sync).

Asymptotics per jet core: seeds = O(nT3(core)) = O(h^3); work = seeds x S x B x deg = O(h^4) with a ~10-FLOP pregate constant; net calls = O(h^3 x S x B x k_pass) with k_pass ~ 2-4 — versus today's O(h^6) visits plus O(h^5) x ~2k-FLOP DNN prefix, twice, serialized onto one block per dense module. The exponent drops from 6 to 4 and the expensive constant moves from O(h^5) to O(h^3).

**K4. FollowSeeds (Wave 2).** Same kernel, Wave-2 seed list, after a barrier. A Wave-2 seed is skipped if >=2 of its 3 MDs are claimed by an accepted Wave-1 track (deterministic: claims depend only on completed Wave-1 output, not launch order). This is the T4/displaced recovery pass; in jets it is deflated because Wave 1 claims most real-track hits.

**K5. ArbitrateTracks.** Replaces the entire dedup/crossclean cascade with propose-verify hit claiming on accepted tracks (~2-20k objects): pass A — each track atomicMax-writes its packed priority (TrackNet score | length | index) onto each of its MDs; pass B — each track counts MDs it won; accepted if unclaimed-or-won fraction >= 0.6 (mirroring today's proportional dup criterion); 2-3 fixed rounds. Shape: one thread per track per round. Cost O(N_tracks x nHits x rounds) ~ 1e6 atomic ops vs today's ~1e9. Two genuinely different tracks share few hits and both survive; same-track redundant seeds collapse.

**K6. PixelGridBuild + K7. AttachPixels.** Section 7. Attaches pLS to accepted OT tracks and to 3-layer "stubs" via a device (eta,phi) grid hash — no superbin maps.

**K8. AssembleTCs.** Reuses today's positional-layer addTrackCandidateToMemory (13 slots). TC types collapse to: pixel+OT merged tracks (pT3/pT5-equivalents), OT-only tracks of 4-11 layers (T4/T5/extended-T5-equivalents), and unclaimed quad pLS. pLS-pLS dedup keeps the eta-sorted CheckHitspLS.

Kernel count from T3s onward: 8 vs ~30 today; host syncs from T3s onward: 1 (seed count) vs ~7.

## 2. WHAT GETS DELETED

Kernels: CountTripletConnectionsT (+ReduceMem), CreateEligibleModulesListForQuintuplets, CreateQuintupletsT (+ReduceMem), ExtendT5FromDupT5, RemoveDupQuintupletsAfterBuild, RemoveDupQuintupletsBeforeTC, AddQuintupletRangesToEventExplicit; the whole T4 stage (CountTripletLSConnectionsT, CreateEligibleModulesListForQuadruplets, CreateQuadrupletsT, RemoveDupQuadrupletsAfterBuild/BeforeTC); CreatePixelQuintupletsFromMap, CreatePixelTripletsFromMap, RemoveDupPixelTripletsFromMap, RemoveDupPixelQuintupletsFromMap; CrossCleanpT3, CrossCleanT5, CrossCleanT4, CrossCleanpLS; both host-side superbin-resolution loops in LSTEvent.dev.cc (807-877, 1077-1148) and their 4 D2H/H2D bounces.

NNs: t5dnn, t5embdnn, plsembdnn, t4dnn, pt3dnn — 5 of 6 deleted (t3dnn stays with the T3 stage). Replaced by 3 (ExtendNet, TrackNet, PixelAttachNet): 6 -> 4 total.

WP/threshold tables: t5dnn kWp (2x10), pt3dnn kWp_pT3/kWpHigh_pT3/kWp_pT5/kWpHigh_pT5 (22 values), t4dnn kWp_displaced/kWp_fake (2x2x25), plsembdnn kWP (10); the 20-region tightCutFlag rzChiSquared table and the loose/tight duality; pT5 rz/rphi/rphiInwards chi2 layer-combo tables; pT3 rz chi2 table; T4 25-bin rz table and the dxy anti-prompt veto; both T5 dBeta selectors and runDeltaBetaIterations (with their explicit beamline terms kDeltaZLum/alphaAbsReg); pT3 radius-consistency interval constants (BBB/BBE/BEE/EEE); all dedup magic numbers (0.1/0.1 windows, d2<0.25, d2<1.0, 8-of-10, 0.2/0.2, minNHitsForDup_*, dR2 constants, the extended-T5 0.03/0.3/6-hit asymmetry).

Maps and machinery: all 12 pixelmap binary files, size_superbins=45000, the 3-family pixelType split and its hardcoded 2 GeV boundary, PixelMap SoA + connectedPixels column, superbin computation in LSTPrepareInput. The module connection map stays (upstream; addendum: retrace with a displaced-vertex helix mix — orthogonal to this design).

Caps: n_max_pixel_triplets=5000 and n_max_pixel_quintuplets=15000 (the silent jet-core truncators), kMaxCompatModules=40, and the kNTripletThreshold=1000 dense-serialization path for T5/T4 (no pair enumeration exists to overflow).

## 3. NN SPECIFICATION

**ExtendNet — 16 -> 16 -> 16 -> 1 (ReLU/ReLU/sigmoid), ~1.1k FLOPs.** Invoked per pregate-surviving continuation candidate inside K3/K4. Inputs (all origin-free unless noted):
1-2. dphi_res, dz_res (barrel) / dr_res (endcap): candidate anchor-MD residuals vs the beam element's propagated helix — differences to a fit through the track's own hits; no origin enters.
3-4. dphi_dir, dlambda_dir: candidate MD's internal two-hit direction vs propagated tangent — angles between direction vectors, translation-invariant.
5. dcurv: |1/R_fit(with candidate) - 1/R_fit(without)| from the incremental circle fit — origin-free (fit through hits only).
6. LS dPhiChange consistency of the candidate LS vs track tangent (delta of two directions; the stored LS alpha is beamline-derived but used only as a *difference* to the local tangent, canceling the reference).
7-8. current curvature 1/R_fit, tanLambda — track-intrinsic.
9. nHits so far / step index.
10-11. r_mod, z_mod of the target module, scaled — *geometry conditioning*, not IP-referencing: they identify material budget and pitch of a fixed detector element. Risk that the net combines (r,z)+tanLambda into a z0 estimate is handled by training (Section 5), and these two features are the designated ablation knobs.
12-14. target module class: barrel/endcap, PS/2S, tilted flags.
15. gap size (layers skipped by this LS).
16. rz chi2 increment of the candidate under the running line fit.
Output: continuation probability; consumed by beam top-B selection and theta_extend.

**TrackNet — 24 -> 32 -> 32 -> 1 (sigmoid), ~2.4k FLOPs.** Invoked once per followed seed reaching >=3 layers. Inputs: nLayers, nHits, final curvature, tanLambda, total rphi chi2/dof and rz chi2/dof of the final fit (origin-free, own-hit-referenced), min/mean/last ExtendNet step scores, per-step residual summary (max residual, scatter), seed t3dnn (fakeScore, promptScore, displacedScore) — the only inherited-IP-flavored inputs, acceptable because they are seed-quality descriptors whose displaced head exists precisely to protect displaced seeds — gap count, start layer, endcap/barrel layer composition (compressed), fraction of PS layers. Output: accept probability against theta_accept(nLayers) (4 scalars: nLayers=4,5,6,>=7). No embedding head: arbitration is hit-based (K5) and pixel crossclean is attach-based (K7), removing the need for a learned metric space entirely.

**PixelAttachNet — 14 -> 16 -> 16 -> 1 (sigmoid), ~0.9k FLOPs.** Invoked per (pLS, OT track-or-stub) grid-matched pair in K7. Inputs: pLS ptIn, ptErr, etaErr, isQuad, charge consistency; residuals of the pLS helix propagated to the OT track's two innermost anchor hits (dphi, dz/dr x2); curvature match (1/R_pLS - 1/R_track); tanLambda difference; OT track nLayers and TrackNet score; radial gap between pLS outer hit and OT innermost hit. IP-referencing is *acceptable here by construction*: pLS are pixel-detector seeds fitted with IP-adjacent constraints; a pixel-attached track is by definition in the prompt-ish population, and displaced OT-only tracks never enter this kernel. Outputs one score with two thresholds: theta_merge (attach hits, form pixel TC) and looser theta_claim (suppress the standalone pLS as a duplicate of the OT track — replacing plsembdnn crossclean).

Total learned thresholds in the whole post-T3 chain: theta_extend, theta_accept x4, theta_merge, theta_claim, arbitration fraction — 8 scalars, versus ~10 binned tables plus dozens of constants today.
